parameters.name: dataSourceName
parameters.description: The name of the data source. Valid values: -search: search for data. -not_search: do not search for data.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the configuration before the modification.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description:
The type of the algorithm. Valid values:

*   pop: a popularity model.
*   cp: a category prediction model.
*   hot: a top search model.
*   hint: a hint model.
*   suggest: a drop-down suggestions model.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun searchengine modify-node-config --instance-id ha-cn-pl32rf00000 --type hot --name ha-cn-pl32rf00000_qrs --cluster-name vpc_sh_domain_2 --data-source-name search --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun searchengine PUT /openapi/ha3/instances/ha-cn-pl32rf00000/node-config --region cn-hangzhou --clusterName vpc_sh_domain_2 --name 'ha-cn-pl32rf00000_qrs' --type hot --dataSourceName search --header "Content-Type=application/json" --body "desc_:_new_version"
